codelens.md.content:
# CodeLens
// CHAT WITH A GITHUB REPO, ANSWERS CITED TO LINES (2026)

RAG code assistant that answers questions about a GitHub repo and cites each answer as file and line range; four pinned demo repos plus guarded indexing of public repos.

• {magenta}Hybrid retrieval in Qdrant{/magenta} (Gemini dense embeddings + BM25 sparse vectors) over line-mapped chunks.
• Prompt chain of query rewrite, retrieval, cited answer and a code check that every citation exists in the retrieved chunks.
• Ingestion guarded by a GitHub size check, single-ingest lock and least-recently-queried pruning.
• Deployed on {green}Vercel and Render with Neon Postgres{/green}.

STACK   : FastAPI / React / Qdrant / PostgreSQL / LangChain / Gemini API / Vercel / Render
